You plan to visit 10 European cities for 23 days in total. You only take direct flights to commute between cities. You would like to visit Rome for 3 days. You want to spend 2 days in Mykonos. You would like to meet your friends at Mykonos between day 10 and day 11 to tour together. You plan to stay in Lisbon for 2 days. You want to spend 5 days in Frankfurt. You are going to attend a wedding in Frankfurt between day 1 and day 5. You plan to stay in Nice for 3 days. You would like to visit Stuttgart for 4 days. You want to spend 4 days in Venice. You plan to stay in Dublin for 2 days. You want to spend 2 days in Bucharest. You plan to stay in Seville for 5 days. During day 13 and day 17, you have to attend a conference in Seville.

Here are the cities that have direct flights:
Rome and Stuttgart, Venice and Rome, Dublin and Bucharest, Mykonos and Rome, Seville and Lisbon, Frankfurt and Venice, Venice and Stuttgart, Bucharest and Lisbon, Nice and Mykonos, Venice and Lisbon, Dublin and Lisbon, Venice and Nice, Rome and Seville, Frankfurt and Rome, Nice and Dublin, Rome and Bucharest, Frankfurt and Dublin, Rome and Dublin, Venice and Dublin, Rome and Lisbon, Frankfurt and Lisbon, Nice and Rome, Frankfurt and Nice, Frankfurt and Stuttgart, Frankfurt and Bucharest, Lisbon and Stuttgart, Nice and Lisbon, Seville and Dublin.

Find a trip plan of visiting the cities for 23 days by taking direct flights to commute between them.

Please output the trip plan in the following JSON format:
{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.

IMPORTANT: When you fly from city A to city B on day X, that day counts for BOTH cities. For example:
- If you stay in Venice from Day 1-3 and fly to Vienna on Day 3, then:
  - Venice: Day 1-3 (3 days)
  - Vienna: Day 3-6 (4 days, including the flight day)
- The flight day (Day 3) is counted for both Venice and Vienna.
- Do NOT create separate flight entries in the JSON.

Below is one valid 23‐day itinerary that uses only direct flights and meets all your date‐ and event–requirements. Notice that when you fly on a “transition day” that day is counted in both the departing city’s stay and the arriving city’s stay. In the plan below:

• You begin in Frankfurt (5 days, which covers the wedding between Day 1 and Day 5).  
• In positions 3–5 you “chain” a pair of 3–day cities (Venice and Nice) around Mykonos so that Mykonos comes in on Day 10–11 (meeting your friends) and the only cities that fly to/from Mykonos (Rome or Nice) are used on its both sides. In our solution the order is Nice after Venice then Mykonos then Rome.  
• Seville is placed so that its 5–day block runs exactly from Day 13 to Day 17 (covering the conference).  
• The remaining four cities are slotted at the end in an order that respects all direct–flight links.

One acceptable solution is as follows. (Remember: The “day_range” for a city is computed by “starting on the flight day into that city” and then adding the number of days; that same day is also the last day of the previous city.) 

Here is the schedule with its computed day ranges:

1. Frankfurt, 5 days: Day 1–5  
2. Venice, 4 days: Day 5–8  
3. Nice, 3 days: Day 8–10  
4. Mykonos, 2 days: Day 10–11  
5. Rome, 3 days: Day 11–13  
6. Seville, 5 days: Day 13–17  
7. Dublin, 2 days: Day 17–18  
8. Bucharest, 2 days: Day 18–19  
9. Lisbon, 2 days: Day 19–20  
10. Stuttgart, 4 days: Day 20–23

Let’s briefly check the critical links and dates:

• Flight legs (using only direct routes):  
 – Frankfurt → Venice (edge exists)  
 – Venice → Nice (direct flight)  
 – Nice → Mykonos (“Nice and Mykonos” is available)  
 – Mykonos → Rome (“Mykonos and Rome” is available)  
 – Rome → Seville (“Rome and Seville” is available)  
 – Seville → Dublin (“Seville and Dublin” is available)  
 – Dublin → Bucharest (“Dublin and Bucharest” is available)  
 – Bucharest → Lisbon (“Bucharest and Lisbon” is available)  
 – Lisbon → Stuttgart (“Lisbon and Stuttgart” is available)

• Special date requirements:  
 – Frankfurt is visited on Days 1–5 (so your wedding in Frankfurt falls within Day 1–5).  
 – Mykonos is visited on Days 10–11 (so you meet your friends between Day 10 and Day 11).  
 – Seville is visited on Days 13–17 (so the Seville conference occurs during that period).

Below is the JSON output in the requested format:

{
  "itinerary": [
    {"day_range": "Day 1-5", "place": "Frankfurt"},
    {"day_range": "Day 5-8", "place": "Venice"},
    {"day_range": "Day 8-10", "place": "Nice"},
    {"day_range": "Day 10-11", "place": "Mykonos"},
    {"day_range": "Day 11-13", "place": "Rome"},
    {"day_range": "Day 13-17", "place": "Seville"},
    {"day_range": "Day 17-18", "place": "Dublin"},
    {"day_range": "Day 18-19", "place": "Bucharest"},
    {"day_range": "Day 19-20", "place": "Lisbon"},
    {"day_range": "Day 20-23", "place": "Stuttgart"}
  ]
}

This itinerary uses exactly 32 individual “city–days” with 9 overlapping flight days so that the overall trip lasts 23 days. All required flights are direct, and every special time constraint is met.
